rules: WS11 owns exact KO1298 wire layouts/fixtures; it does not own combat semantics.
WS03 owns session-state gating, dispatch, and authenticated actor binding; client source/result hints are never authoritative.
A provider may own semantic handling while WS03 owns routing of the same opcode.
WS19 owns combat validation/damage/skill/resource semantics; WS25 owns mob lifecycle, not packet encoding.
0x1D is not a semantic collision: WS14 owns world bootstrap/request lifecycle; WS16 owns NPC record/detail semantics used to satisfy it.
Unknown or partially specified wire layouts remain blocked from production encoding.
